facts.fact: Decree 59/2019, approved by the Council of Ministers on 2 April 2019 and in force on publication on 3 July 2019, creates the Mozambique Digital Certification System, with a State Root Certification Authority, and approves its regulation.
facts.system: Sistema de Certificação Digital de Moçambique (SCDM)

systems.system: Sistema de Certificação Digital de Moçambique (SCDM)
systems.tiers: State Root Certification Authority; certification entities; registration entities
